papers.title: Measurement of the Compton scattering in germanium with a p-type point-contact germanium detector for dark matter detection
papers.summary: Low-energy background through Compton scattering from the ambient $γ$ rays can be contaminated in direct dark matter search experiments. In this paper, we report comparable measurements on low-energy spectra via Compton scattering from several $γ$-ray sources with a p-type point-contact germanium detector.
